page.layout: Two columns of an alphabetical index on a curled page, with the binding shadow over the left side. Left column: the main index, running from the top of the page to the bottom. Right column, at the far right edge and partly hidden by the curl: fragments of a second column of index entries. Below the right column, a few lines of a cut-off third block. The "Digitized by Google" credit at the bottom right is not transcribed.

page.notes: Photographed page, strongly curled toward the binding; the left side is in shadow and the right-hand column is cut off by the edge of the page, so most right-column lines are only partly legible and are given in fragments. Words ending in [?] are doubtful. The page is an index of the "M" section, without a visible running head, page number or catchword. The top-left corner also carries a second column of catchwords, which is not separately legible. The Digitized by Google credit is excluded.
